selection.concrete_consumer: Public storefront, owner dashboard invoices, and future failover rails
selection.reason: Commons needed a provider-neutral chargeability registry so Stripe failing closed cannot freeze buyer intake, without pretending PayPal/Sponsors/Square are live.

before.evidence: checkout_capability snapshot was Stripe-only; failover was mailto only

after.producing_outcome: Registry names Stripe CHARGEABLE with verified settlement last4 7243 and keeps PayPal, GitHub Sponsors, and Square INERT with one-click owner actions. Cash USD 0.

non_claims: No credentials, KYC, bank, OTP, or provider approval entered
No PayPal.me, Sponsors profile, or Square checkout invented
No charge, payout, buyer, or cash
No remint of SKUs or Payment Links
